```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(openxlsx)
library(broom)


```

Loading file
```{r}
met_outcomes <-  readRDS(file = "../Outputs/met_cohort_outcomes.RData")
met_data <-  readRDS(file = "../Outputs/met_cohort_data.RData")
```

Splitting by cohort and outcome
```{r}
pt.status <- filter(met_outcomes, Sample %in% met_data$Sample)
tc.tox.outcomes <- filter(pt.status, Reason.for.discontinuation == "Therapy complete" | Reason.for.discontinuation == "Toxicity")
tc.tox.data <- filter(met_data, (Sample %in% tc.tox.outcomes$Sample))
```

```{r}
#renaming column and merging 
tc.tox.df <- left_join(tc.tox.outcomes, tc.tox.data, by = c("Sample" = "Sample" ))
#adding numbers for outcome
tc.tox.df <- tc.tox.df %>% mutate(Outcome = case_when(
  Reason.for.discontinuation == "Therapy complete" ~ 1,
  TRUE ~ 0))


# Get a vector of gene names
genes <- colnames(tc.tox.df[, 4:82])
fixed.genes <- make.names(colnames(tc.tox.df[, 4:82]))

#renaming columns to ones that don't produce an error
fixed.tc.tox.df <- tc.tox.df %>% 
  rename_with(~ fixed.genes[which((genes) == .x)], .cols = any_of(genes))

#create data frame to store the output 
logr_tox_metastatic <- (data.frame(gene = genes,
                   estimate = NA,
                   p.value = NA))


geneoutcome <- fixed.tc.tox.df %>%
  select(-Sample, -Reason.for.discontinuation) 


#might have a - sign. Will put to console, might want to assign it

for (g in 1:length(fixed.genes)) {
  f <- as.formula(paste0("Outcome ~ ",fixed.genes[g]))
   tmp <- glm(formula = f, data = geneoutcome, family = binomial)
   tmpdf <- broom::tidy(tmp)
#  retrieve the line of interest with g, estimate, and p-value
   logr_tox_metastatic$estimate[g] <- tmpdf$estimate[2]
   logr_tox_metastatic$p.value[g] <- tmpdf$p.value[2]
 
}
logr_tox_metastatic <- logr_tox_metastatic %>%
   mutate(FDR = p.adjust(p.value)) %>%
   arrange(FDR) 

labeled_data <- logr_tox_metastatic %>%
  filter(gene == "CD80" |
           gene == "CEACAM1" |
           gene == "SPI1" |
           gene == "SPN" |
           gene == "HAVCR2") 



logr_tox_metastatic_graph <- ggplot(data = logr_tox_metastatic, aes(x = estimate, y = p.value)) +
            geom_point(color = "black") +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  geom_point(
    data = labeled_data,
    color = "red",) +
# geom_text_repel(
#     data = labeled_data,
#     aes(label = gene),
#     # nudge_x = 0.0, 
#     # nudge_y = -0.4
#     ) + 
  ylab("p-value") +
  xlab("log(OR)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 28, face = "bold"), 
    axis.text = element_text(size = 20),  
    # plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold")
  ) 


print(logr_tox_metastatic_graph)

save(logr_tox_metastatic, file = "../Outputs/logr_tox_metastatic.Rdata")

```
